main_subject.detail: Cinematic sports viewing poster with a gold World Cup trophy at center, one England player in white on the left, one Congo player in blue on the right, and a glowing match-card interface with booking CTA.

Background is a bar interior blended with stadium screens and dramatic spotlighting. Surrounding elements: giant title 'WORLD CUP 2026', subheadline 'LỊCH TRỰC TIẾP TẠI QUÁN NHẬU TỰ DO', location tag 'PARKING ZONE 4', team labels 'ANH' and 'CONGO', time '23:00', date 'THỨ TƯ 01.07.2026', red CTA 'ĐẶT BÀN NGAY!', and footer contacts. Technical style: photorealistic sports-event poster compositing, cinematic stadium lighting, trophy bloom and golden sparks, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
